subject: NovumHealth pilot: temporary uptime/latency waiver for gorilla-v2-preview
messages:
From: Alice Brown <alice.brown@novumhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SLA waiver for gorilla-v2-preview during pilot

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the team at NovumHealth is excited to move forward with a 6-week pilot of 'gorilla-v2-preview' for triage assistance. One outstanding item from procurement and our clinical ops team is confirmation on SLAs. Because 'gorilla-v2-preview' is marked as a preview model, our legal/procurement folks are asking whether Redwood can commit to a temporary uptime/latency carveout — specifically: 99.5% uptime and 200ms P95 — for the pilot period.

Can you let me know if Redwood can provide an exception and what safeguards you'd put in place so we can sign off? We need to present a short mitigation plan to our clinical compliance and procurement by Aug 18.

Attachments: pilot_scope.pdf (we'll send SOW after SLA terms)

Thanks,
Alice Brown
Head of Clinical Integrations
NovumHealth
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Alice Brown <alice.brown@novumhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA waiver for gorilla-v2-preview during pilot

Hi Alice — appreciate the clear ask and timeline. We can consider a temporary exception for a defined pilot window with conditions.

High level proposed approach (will validate with SRE/legal):
- Duration: 8 weeks from pilot start (pilot requested is 6 weeks; we'll provision an extra 2-week stabilization buffer)
- Temporary SLA: 99.5% uptime and 200ms P95 for the 'gorilla-v2-preview' endpoint only
- Guardrails: mandatory fallback to a GA-stable variant ('gorilla-v2-stable'), dedicated capacity reservation during peak hours, and enhanced monitoring + Pager duty coverage
- Documentation: complete an SLA exception form and attach a short mitigation plan for your compliance team

I've looped in Vivek and Markus from SRE and Laura for procurement coordination. I'll compile a formal exception packet (SLA form + MOP) by EOD Aug 13. If you can share the procurement contact, we'll include a DocuSign link for the SOW.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NovumHealth pilot — request for temporary SLA (gorilla-v2-preview)

Team — NovumHealth wants a temporary SLA carveout for their upcoming pilot. Key asks from external: 99.5% uptime, 200ms P95, 6-week pilot (we're proposing 8 wks).

Proposed mitigations I think we should include in the exception packet:
- Dedicated pool: reserve 2x standard instances during 8a-6p PT weekdays for pilot traffic
- Canary ramp: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 48 hours with automatic rollback to 'gorilla-v2-stable' if p95 > 250ms for 5 consecutive minutes
- Prefix/KV caching and request coalescing enabled for NovumHealth's route
- Enhanced observability: 1s token-level traces, cost/latency alerts, and weekly quality checks
- Financial: temporary add-on surcharge to cover dedicated capacity (we'll attach cost worksheet)

Attachments: sla-exception-form.pdf, novum_pilot_mop_v1.pdf, dedicated-pool-costs.xlsx

Please review and flag any operational blockers or legal constraints. If SRE signs off, we'll send the packet to Alice and procurement with a DocuSign SOW and HubSpot update.

Thanks,
Tessa
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: NovumHealth pilot — request for temporary SLA (gorilla-v2-preview)

Thanks for the summary. I'm open to a controlled exception but only with these mandatory controls:
1) Fallback mapping: for every endpoint on 'gorilla-v2-preview' we must have an automated mapping to 'gorilla-v2-stable' with zero-touch failover (no manual intervention required). We'll need to ship a mapping config before pilot start.
2) Autoscaling headroom: reserve an emergency burst pool (we can enable but it will incur cost) that triggers at 85% avg GPU utilization per node.
3) Canary safety guard: change your rollback threshold to p95 > 220ms sustained for 3 minutes (we'll be stricter).
4) Postmortem commitment: any incident that breaches the temporary SLA requires a 72-hour joint postmortem and a remediation plan with dates.

Operational notes: we'll need a 72-hour lead time to configure the dedicated pool and test the failover. Also legal needs the SLA exception form filled — we should not accept open-ended language about 'preview' features in the public SLA.

See runbook snippet: On high-latency events we flip routing to stable variant and throttle non-critical requests (link: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/model-fallback).

If these are acceptable, I can sign off and coordinate the infra changes.

— Vivek
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Alice Brown <alice.brown@novumhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA waiver for gorilla-v2-preview during pilot — Mitigation packet and next steps

Hi Alice / Procurement — attached is the formal exception packet we discussed. Summary of the agreed controls:
- Temporary SLA: 99.5% uptime and 200ms P95 for gorilla-v2-preview only, effective for 8 weeks from pilot start date.
- Automated fallback to gorilla-v2-stable with zero-touch failover if p95 > 220ms for 3 minutes.
- Dedicated capacity reserved for 8a-6p PT weekdays plus an emergency burst pool.
- Monitoring: token-level traces, 1-minute SLO alerts, and joint weekly quality review.
- Incident response: 72-hour joint postmortem and remediation schedule for any SLA breach.
- Commercial: one-time pilot capacity surcharge (see attached costs) and DocuSign link for SOW: https://docusign.example/signon/abcdef123456

Attachments included: sla-exception-form.pdf, novum_pilot_mop_v1.pdf, dedicated-pool-costs.xlsx

If procurement is comfortable, please sign the DocuSign SOW and reply with a proposed pilot start date (we will require 72 hours to provision infra). Once signed we will schedule a kickoff and run the canary plan.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
